newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar settles down slightly, trade slim.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar settles down slightly, trade slim.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed lower and within the recent range after a thinly-traded session, floor sources said.
Volume was estimated at 11,326 lots compared to Tuesday's official 16,725 lots.
Dealers said trade buying of the May/July spread around 0.21 cent was the day's main feature. "Everytime it looked weak, spread buying would come in and hold the market," a floor source said.
The trade and commission houses were cited as the major sellers while the trade also bought May futures outright and on a scale-down basis.
This pattern is expected to dominate activity and keep prices within their 10.68-11.09 range until players begin to roll May positions into the deferred months, dealers said.
A move under 10.70 basis May could also run the contract into sell stops at 10.68 cents, they added.
The spot month settled down 0.05 at 10.81 cents a lb, having ranged from 10.88 to 10.78. The back months ended 0.03 to 0.08 cent weaker.
Open interest in most-active May rose 985 lots to 62,173 lots as of Tuesday's close.
